newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tricom 1996 net down 37.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Tricom 1996 net down 37.2 percent.

text.p: NOTE - Telecommunications concern Tricom Holdings supplies telephone systems, office automation and personal communications products.

In April 1996, the group ceased its mobile phone distribution business which comprised of a direct and retail sales team of approximately 50 staff and a chain of nine retail shops in Hong Kong. The trading results of this division for the current year and the prior year have been shown as discontinued operations. An exceptional loss of approximately HK$2.49 million was incurred as a result of the cessation of the mobile phone distribution business and was included under the caption of "profit-discontinued operations" in 1996.
Total dividend for year is three H.K. cents vs four cents.
